synthetic.criterion: object-frames whose visible box is covered at least 99% by the blur, gap method in the name
synthetic.oracle: the retries and the second looks are simulated from the truth (a retry returns the real box, a verification always confirms): this is the share of object-frames covered with perfect recovery, a ceiling, not recall of the whole pipeline. State it with the figure.

standard_vs_maximum.speedup_what: analysis time of Maximum over Standard, the face detector alone: what Maximum costs, not an advantage of Standard
standard_vs_maximum.scope: face detector only, two public clips, 52 frames labelled by hand

speed.settings: faces and plates, Standard, default margins; analyze + render, one process

memory.what: peak resident set of the process right after the analysis, models loaded

rerender.what: (analyze + render) over a second render after set_blur on one item; no detector runs in it

speed_busy.settings: faces and plates, Standard, default margins; analyze + render, one process

memory_busy.what: peak resident set of the process right after the analysis, models loaded

rerender_busy.what: (analyze + render) over a second render after set_blur on one item; no detector runs in it

photo_speed.settings: faces and plates together, Standard, through the public API (analyze, then render)

stop.what: seconds from CancelToken.cancel(), called from another thread at an arbitrary moment, to Cancelled being raised, on the 1080p clip, in one process; the requirement holds on a free machine

engine.standard_vs_maximum.coverage_pct.why: 6 of the 7 faces that Maximum blurred, in one street clip with 22 labelled faces: a handful of cases (95 % interval 48.7-97.4), inside the noise; the same sample cannot say whether Maximum finds more faces than Standard (9 against 7, and Maximum itself gave 8 and 7 faces in two runs of the same code). bench/truth/faces/README.md.

engine.standard_vs_maximum.coverage.why: 6 of the 7 faces that Maximum blurred, in one street clip with 22 labelled faces: a handful of cases (95 % interval 48.7-97.4), inside the noise; the same sample cannot say whether Maximum finds more faces than Standard (9 against 7, and Maximum itself gave 8 and 7 faces in two runs of the same code). bench/truth/faces/README.md.

engine.rerender.why: measured on a clip with 0 items and 0.0 % of its frames blurred: no decision was changed and the second render has no blur to redo; the figure of the clip with a blurred box in most frames is engine.rerender_busy

tests.what: test cases that `unittest discover -s tests -t .` finds (a class that skips as a whole still counts each of its cases); a run reports fewer when this machine skips some
